§6Plutonium-241§f

§aThe rarest plutonium isotope. Your gateway to americium.§f

Pu-241 is the least common plutonium isotope but much more potent than Pu-239. It's the gateway to producing §bAmericium-241§f and §bAmericium-242m§f.

Properties: §e25.0§f RAD/s (hottest Pu isotope), fissile, hard difficulty.

Production: RBMK Reactor Pu-239 fuel depletes to produce Pu-239 and Pu-240 waste. Process waste in a SILEX: Pu-239 waste contains §e25%§f Pu-241, Pu-240 waste contains §e15%§f. Pu-241 ZFB rods require an initial investment but return substantially more.

Main use is §bHEP-241§f RBMK fuel (8 Pu-241 billets per rod), the strongest plutonium fuel with high heat output. Depletes into Am-241 and Am-242m.

Also used in ZFB fuels (Bismuth ZFB, Pu-241 ZFB, Reactor Grade Americium ZFB).

§ePS:§f Set up RBMK Pu-239 fuel, process the waste in a SILEX, and extract Pu-241 for HEP-241 fuel rods.
